El SQL corre **en Databricks**. A local solo baja el resultado chico (agregados / `LIMIT`).

```{python}
import os
from pathlib import Path

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from databricks import sql
import pandas as pd

_p = Path.cwd().resolve()
for _ in range(8):
    load_dotenv(_p / ".env")
    _p = _p.parent

GOLD = os.environ.get("GOLD_TABLE", "workspace.default.gold_ventas")

conn = sql.connect(
    server_hostname=os.environ["DATABRICKS_HOST"].replace("https://", ""),
    http_path=os.environ["DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH"],
    access_token=os.environ["DATABRICKS_TOKEN"],
)

def q(sql_text: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(sql_text)
        rows = cur.fetchall()
        cols = [c[0] for c in cur.description]
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=cols)
```

```{python}
# Esquema y volumen (1 fila). No hagas SELECT * de 100M filas.
q(f"DESCRIBE TABLE {GOLD}")
```

```{python}
q(f"SELECT COUNT(*) AS filas FROM {GOLD}")
```

```{python}
# Cambia el GROUP BY según las columnas reales de gold
df = q(
    f"""
    SELECT *
    FROM {GOLD}
    LIMIT 1000
    """
)
df.head()
```
